notes: Beta: your station's page on mayflowerstudios.net can now play the stream itself. Turn on "Also give my stations an https address" under Settings > Connection — no account or router setup, it fetches a helper once. While it's on, listeners never see your home IP. The address changes each time the app starts, so a link shared by hand goes stale; your usual address keeps working either way. Needs the updated FirebaseRules-full.json.
